_comment: Known CloudWatch dimension names per namespace. CloudWatch publishes a metric once per dimension set and New Relic stores every set under the same metric name, so a query that filters on only some dimensions would add the sets together (seen on API Gateway: ApiName-only + ApiName/Stage rows doubled a count). The converter therefore adds `<dimension> IS NULL` for every dimension listed here that the alarm does not use. Over-listing is harmless; a dimension missing from this list can still leak. Confirmed 2026-10-05 for AWS/ApiGateway (ApiName vs ApiName+Stage).
